svg.aria-label: Keyryx: custody signs for granted consumers and publishes key sets, and a read-only witness signs its tree heads and reports a rewritten stream
svg.title: Keyryx: custody signs for granted consumers and publishes key sets, and a read-only witness signs its tree heads and reports a rewritten stream

g.text: signs for the consumers it grants
or proof in, key statement back
use log, one line per use
verify locally, no call per request
keep verifying when custody is down
no launcher sets an admin key, so 403
new key beside old, then old retired
sealed, when a folder is set
its own process, key and volume
reads, writes only its own files
